observations.what: This filer writes the PIK margin as 'S + X Cash plus Y % PIK' or 'S + X Cash (includes Y % PIK)' and neither wording fixes what X is. 'Includes' with X = total: Curia, Zeus 2025-09-30. 'Includes' with X = cash leg: Legends (275, total 550) and Titan (238 + 288) 2025-09-30, published 2.75 / 2.38 until aoud. Decided per loan from the same position at the same maturity in other quarters (pik_history_aouc.txt); 13 row corrections.
